what.text: This page follows refugees from Pakistan living in the United States, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 4005 Pakistani refugees in the United States, 4.4% of all refugees from Pakistan.
Afghanistan hosts the most Pakistani refugees, followed by the United Kingdom, Italy and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Pakistan in every year from 2007 to 2025, with the TTP and Lashkar-e-Islam among the opponents.
It also records armed conflict over Balochistan territory in periods from 2004 to 2025, and with the Islamic State group in some years since 2016.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1988 at 63 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 4211, at the end of 2006; the main years of displacement in the data are 1998 to 2003 and 2005 to 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in the United States.
These are year-end totals for the United States only, reported to UNHCR.
